title: WHEN GOD SAYS IT IS TIME TO MOVE

memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: Then we turned back and set out toward the wilderness along the route to the Red Sea, as the Lord had directed me. For a long time we made our way around the hill country of Seir. Then the Lord said to me, "You have made your way around this hill country long enough; now turn north." - Deut 2:1-3 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
Moses continues his account of the wilderness years. After the failure at Kadesh, the people spent "a long time" circling the hill country of Seir, going round and round without progress. Then, at last, God spoke: "You have made your way around this hill country long enough; now turn north." There was a season of waiting, and then there was a moment to move. Both were under God's direction.

There is comfort here for anyone who feels stuck in a season of going in circles. Those years of wandering were not outside God's knowledge; they were part of His dealing with His people. And when the time was right, He clearly said, "Enough. Now move forward." God knows exactly how long each season should last, and He is faithful to signal when it is time to advance.

Sometimes we grow weary of waiting, feeling we are circling the same mountain with no end in sight. But God is not idle in those seasons, and He has not forgotten us. There is a purpose in the waiting and a time appointed for the moving. Our part is to keep walking with Him and to be ready when He says, "Now turn north."

The God who directed Israel's steps directs ours too. He orders our seasons with wisdom, both the times of waiting and the times of advance. As we walk with Him, we can trust that He will make the way clear at the right moment. For there is a time for everything under heaven (Eccl 3:1), and the One who leads us is perfectly faithful in His timing. Keep trusting; your "turn north" will come.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
1. Do you feel stuck circling the same mountain in some area of life?
2. How does it help to know God appoints both the waiting and the moving?
3. Are you ready to move when God says "now"?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Lord, thank You that You order my seasons with perfect wisdom, both the waiting and the advancing. Help me to walk faithfully with You and to move promptly when You say it is time. Amen.
